title: Two-factor sign-in (TOTP) and a stronger password policy
goal: Let staff protect their accounts with an authenticator app code and require stronger passwords.
why: No 2FA exists; passwords need only 8 characters (audit 02); GDPR-style buyers in the UK/EU expect 2FA.
steps: utils/totp.ts: RFC 6238 TOTP (HMAC-SHA1 via WebCrypto, 30 s, 6 digits, ±1 step), base32 secret generation, otpauth URI; no new dependency.
Tenant 0049: users ADD totp_secret_enc TEXT, totp_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 0, recovery_codes_hash TEXT (JSON of SHA-256 hashes). Secret encrypted with crypto-box (R108).

Endpoints: POST /auth/2fa/setup (returns otpauth URI and secret once), POST /auth/2fa/enable (verify a code), POST /auth/2fa/disable (password + code), login returns { requires2fa, challengeToken } when enabled, POST /auth/2fa/verify (challengeToken + code or recovery code) issues tokens; 5 attempts per challenge; admin can require 2FA for all users (setting require_2fa).
Password policy in utils/password.ts validatePassword: 12+ characters, not equal to email, not in a short built-in list of common passwords; used by change-password, reset, setup-account and invites.

Desktop: login step for the code; Settings > Security: enable 2FA with a QR code (render the otpauth URI as QR with a tiny inline encoder or show the secret as text if no QR library exists; do not add a dependency without saying so), recovery codes download.
tests: backend/test/two-factor.test.ts: RFC 6238 test vectors; enable/verify/disable; wrong code 5 times locks the challenge; recovery code works once; weak password rejected.
desktop/e2e/two-factor.spec.ts: enrol, log out, log in with a code computed in the test from the secret.
acceptance: Seeded e2e users without 2FA are unaffected.
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/two-factor.spec.ts e2e/auth-shell.spec.ts e2e/token-refresh.spec.ts
goLiveVerify: Super admin 2FA (follow-up, not in this batch).
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.

Desktop UI follows desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md (ds-* tokens, archetypes, FilterBar + infinite scroll, RelationCombobox, PhoneInput, useConfirm, graceful degradation). lint-gate must not rise for any touched file.
The demo password Admin@123 is shorter than 12: the policy applies to new passwords only; do not break seeded logins.
